/playground/wind-rain/.title: Do offshore wind farms take the rain from the coast? | Kvantix Data Playground
og: A 2026 study projects 10–15 % less coastal rain after a huge North Sea wind build-out. We test today's farms against 35 years of rain gauges, every rule locked first.
Do offshore wind farms take the rain?
55 offshore farms, 1,384 rain gauges, 0 rain values read so far. The method was locked before the data, including a test of Thor before it is finished.
